summary: Completed live backend and frontend regression for editable inventory stock. OTP, plus/minus, typed blur persistence after reload, zero clamp in UI, product edit fields, society filtering, order customer hydration, order stepper, delivery status, and mobile layout passed.

minor.issue: PUT accepts and persists negative stock (tested stock=-3 returns 200 and GET returns -3). The UI clamps below-zero interactions, but the API does not enforce the stock invariant for direct callers or concurrent clients.

action_items: Add server-side validation (for example, a nonnegative constraint) to Product.stock and reject negative PUT/POST values with 400/422.
Add a regression assertion for negative product stock so the API cannot bypass the inventory UI guard.
critical_code_review_comments: Product.stock is typed as plain int and update_product replaces the document without checking a nonnegative bound; client-side Math.max(0, ...) is not sufficient to protect persisted inventory data.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 regression checks; negative-stock edge check exposed defect)

seed_data_creation: Existing preview data was used. Backend regression tests created additional TEST-prefixed products/customers; live stock was restored after the direct API edge check. One existing product availability value was preserved by the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-test negative stock POST/PUT validation after the backend fix. Live browser coverage passed OTP with demo code 123456, inventory controls and reload persistence, availability/price modal fields, society filter, order customer hydration, order quantity stepper, delivery status, and 390px mobile layout. Phone SMS OTP is MOCKED; no Twilio integration is connected.
rca of the issue: The Inventory component applies Math.max(0, Number(value)||0) only before its own PUT calls. The FastAPI Product model and update_product endpoint accept any integer, and replace_one persists it unchanged. Reproduction: PUT /api/products/{id} with the existing product payload and stock=-3 returns 200; subsequent GET returns stock=-3.
